annotations.title: Get the booking or quote link

description: Get the link the user must open to book a scheduled SYMONE trip or to request a quote for another route or date, plus reservation contacts. With route_id (from search_routes) the trip details are repeated next to the link. With need "quote" and the trip details, the link opens the quote form already filled in: the customer checks it, adds their own contact details and sends it (use it when the customer prefers to send the request themselves). Booking and payment happen on symone.fr only.

departure_city.description: Optional, need 'quote': pick-up city, e.g. 'Lyon' or '93200 Saint-Denis'.

departure_date.description: Optional, need 'quote': date YYYY-MM-DD or a period in words ('mid-December').

models.description: Optional, need 'quote': one make and model per motorcycle, e.g. ['BMW R 1250 GS'].

need.description: 'scheduled_trip' to book a trip listed by search_routes, 'quote' to request a quote for a route or date that is not listed.

paris_details.description: Optional, need 'quote': arrondissement, nearby town or flexibility when Paris is the departure or arrival.

return_date.description: Optional, need 'quote': return date for a round trip.

riders.description: Optional, need 'quote': people travelling with the motorcycles (0 = motorcycles only).

route_id.description: Optional id of a trip returned by search_routes.
